data.body:
[P2] Require successful progress from the timeout retry

Both deadline cases can report `retry-replay` as passed when the retry emits `ENTER` and then fails or remains suspended: this checker only requires another request and one execution of the original success body. The caller never checks the victim's terminal result, and teardown stops unfinished executions. This misses regressions where cancellation state incorrectly prevents the retry from continuing. Require successful victim completion with the expected result and `after-deadline` work attributed to a retry request; add a negative control where the retry enters but makes no durable progress.
